entry: 2 tranches: half after the Oct 2 Q3 deliveries print and the NHTSA Special Order outcome (sworn response due Sept 30) are known, half after Q3 earnings (Oct 28, 2026 after close; some calendars show Oct 21-23), and only if robotaxi expansion and the capex/debt plan do not break the thesis. Skip the second half on a close near the $255 thesis break
overlap: SPCX most directly (Musk key-person risk and the ~48% Tesla-SpaceX merger wildcard, whose price effect is two-sided); GOOGL (Waymo is the direct robotaxi rival, so autonomy news moves them against each other); AVGO, CRDO, VRT, META and GOOGL share the high-multiple AI and growth factor, and BE and UUUU share only high-beta risk
reason: The blended target (~$379) is only ~6% above the $357 close, while fair value (~$285) sits ~20-23% below it and IV runs ~49%. Nearly all the value is autonomy and Optimus option value, so the view hangs on one contested assumption: that the narrative premium holds while robotaxi is in 2 states against a 12-state goal, deliveries fall YoY and FCF is negative. It is very liquid and long-listed, but NHTSA, deliveries and earnings all land within a month, so cap it at ~5% (~$750) and stage the entry.
